newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde June 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde June 5.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- New government to face challenge of slow growth, as first quarter 1997 GDP rose 0.2 percent only. President Jacques Chirac at first cabinet meeting this morning called for left-right power-sharing to be marked by "dignity and mutual respect".
-- Bouygues seeks partners to finance development of diversified activity
-- CFDT union leader Nicole Notat says her role is to defend public service mission of utility companies, but that it is not necessarily incompatible with an opening of the capital of France Telecom.
-- Axa U.S.-based investment banking subsidiary Donaldson Lufkin Jenrette attracts interest from potential buyers due to high performance.
-- Renault unions to meet industry minister over possible alternatives to a planned shutdown of Belgian plant.
-- Media group Pathe plans to tighten ties with French film producers, does not rule out buying or creating new theme-based digital TV channels.
